borderline.note: UKSCQA recommends a zone of consideration ≤ 2pp below a boundary with no additional rounding (68.0 may be reconsidered for a First; 67.99 not). Mechanics vary by university — the tool offers an override.

alevel.note: JCQ/Ofqual. No A* at AS (A–E only). X = incomplete. Boundaries set per series by boards after marking.

gcse.anchor_points: Ofqual: bottom of 7 = bottom of old A; bottom of 4 = bottom of old C; bottom of 1 = bottom of old G; 9 sits above old A*.
gcse.note: Ofqual. Grade-order only — no GPA math. Boundaries set per exam series per board after marking; never hard-code. Grade 4 = standard pass, grade 5 = strong pass (DfE).

name: United Kingdom (degree classification)
notes: UK classification is computed from weighted module MARKS, not a grade→points table. The tool needs the university's year weighting (four UKSCQA presets offered) plus a borderline override. GCSE/A-level modes are grade-order reference only.
